summary: Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, announcing a 15-for-1 share consolidation of its Class A, B and C ordinary shares, effective September 14, 2026. Class A shares (NASDAQ: CPOP) trade post-consolidation from that date under new CUSIP G71700135. Outstanding Class A shares fall from 14,069,656 to roughly 937,978, with fractional shares rounded up; options, warrants and similar rights adjust proportionately. No price, premium or advisor is stated. This is a routine capital-structure action, typically aimed at regaining Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance, not a special situation; watch for reverse-split-driven price volatility and possible subsequent equity issuance.
